title: Ajmera Realty & Infra India
extract: Ajmera Realty & Infra India is a listed company based in Mumbai, India, founded in 1985 as Percolated Steels. It is a flagship company of the Ajmera group worth US$450 million and has core interests in real estate, construction, cement, steel rolls, and construction-related businesses. The company has diversified into solar power and seamless capsules.
